inputs.text:
Well folks, you need to hear what these progressive elites in Albany are up to with their 2026 State of the State agenda. They are launching a direct assault on our traditions, our constitutional heritage, and the basic freedom we all have to protect our families and homes. 

They are pushing legislation that dictates how firearms sold in New York must be designed to prevent them from being modified, while slapping even more heavy-handed criminal penalties on law-abiding citizens. It is classic government overreach. Instead of focusing on law and order, personal responsibility, and holding actual criminals accountable, these ruling elites are attacking decent, hard-working people and eroding our fundamental Second Amendment rights. It is time to stand up for our liberties and put a stop to this nonsense.
